'''Armor''' in Matcha Flavoured comes in twelve sets. Base-metal sets are crafted; alloy sets are smithed onto copper, iron or diamond armor. Several sets have intrinsics, and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] sets have a [[Set bonus|set bonus]].

In the video, the developer wanted every set to be "enticing enough that every player will have a different idea on what the best set and combination is."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=The goal with these sets was to make each option enticing enough that every player will have a different idea on what the best set and combination is.}}</ref>

== Full sets ==
{{Data/Armor/Sets
|Copper=The cheapest metal set; plain copper armor protects undead from [[Warding]].
|Iron=Vanilla armor values with 350 durability per piece.
|Steel=Knockback resistance (0.5 for the full set) and [[Blast Protection]] on every piece. In 1.12.2 the armor is invisible when worn.
|Golden=[[Fire Protection]] on every piece.
|Diamond=800 durability per piece; the base for electrum and adamant.
|Shakudo=[[Cleanse]], [[magic protection]] and a regeneration effect that grows with each piece worn.
|Hepatizon=Each piece adds 10% movement speed.
|Electrum=Each piece adds a level of [[Warding]]; the full set reaches warding 4 and grants Absorption.
|Adamant=[[Doom]] on every piece, plus Protection I, Unbreaking II and knockback resistance.
|Leather=Every piece adds 1 block of safe fall distance.
|Sturdy Leather=Projectile Protection and 2 blocks of safe fall distance per piece; the boots add step height.
|Chainmail=Craftable from iron chains; every piece has Thorns III.
}}
